article_title: Leonid meteor shower 2026: How and when to see it this weekend

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: When the Leonid meteor shower can be seen, how to watch it, and how UK weather may affect the view
Why a new telescope is being built in Wales
How astronauts collect dust from comets
Why the constellation Leo is disappearing
tasks.correct_answer: When the Leonid meteor shower can be seen, how to watch it, and how UK weather may affect the view
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה מתי מתרחש מטר הלאונידים, איך לצפות בו ומה צפוי במזג האוויר בבריטניה.

tasks.prompt: When is the Leonid meteor shower expected to reach its peak?
options: On 7 November
On the night of 17 November
On 30 November
At the end of December
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, המטר נמשך עד 30 בנובמבר אך מגיע לשיא בלילה של 17 בנובמבר.

tasks.prompt: What does “radiant” mean in the article?
options: The brightest meteor in the shower
A device used to measure cloud
The point in the sky from which the meteors seem to appear
Light reflected from the Moon
tasks.correct_answer: The point in the sky from which the meteors seem to appear
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Radiant הוא הנקודה שממנה נראה כאילו המטאורים יוצאים; אצל הלאונידים היא ליד ראש קבוצת הכוכבים אריה.

tasks.prompt: What equipment does the article say is needed to see the Leonids?
options: A powerful telescope
Special night-vision glasses
Binoculars and a star map
No special equipment because they are visible to the naked eye
tasks.correct_answer: No special equipment because they are visible to the naked eye
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הלאונידים נראים בעין בלתי מזוינת, ולכן אין צורך במשקפת או בטלסקופ.

tasks.prompt: Where were the best chances of clear skies expected on Friday and Saturday nights?
options: Southern and western parts of England and Wales
Northern Ireland and northern Scotland
Only central London
Every part of the UK equally
tasks.correct_answer: Southern and western parts of England and Wales
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התחזית הצביעה על הסיכוי הטוב ביותר לשמים בהירים בדרום ובמערב אנגליה וויילס.

tasks.prompt: Why could viewing conditions be especially good around the middle-of-November peak?
options: The meteors will move more slowly.
Street lights will be switched off.
The Moon will be below the horizon around midnight, reducing reflected light.
Fog always disappears after midnight.
tasks.correct_answer: The Moon will be below the horizon around midnight, reducing reflected light.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר הירח מתחת לאופק בסביבות חצות, האור המוחזר ממנו פחות מפריע לראות מטאורים חלשים.

tasks.prompt: List four practical steps the article recommends for watching the Leonids.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין ארבע המלצות מעשיות שונות מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Choose a safe, dark place away from street lights and other light pollution.
Use a wide open space with a broad view of the sky.
Allow about 20 to 30 minutes for your eyes to adapt to the dark.
Look generally at the sky but focus near the head of the constellation Leo.
Check the local cloud, fog and temperature forecast.
Dress warmly for single-figure temperatures and possible frost.

tasks.prompt: Explain why a clear Sunday night might still give some sky watchers a poor view.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הקשר בין שמים בהירים, היווצרות ערפל והסתרת המטאורים.
expected_points: More areas may have clear skies on Sunday night.
Fog can form where skies remain clear for a period of time.
Fog can obscure the night sky even when there is little cloud.
Viewers should check the local fog forecast as well as cloud cover.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the timing, cause, viewing advice and weather outlook for the Leonids in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מועד השיא, מקור המטאורים, עצות צפייה מרכזיות והשפעת העננות או הערפל.
expected_points: The Leonids are visible during November and peak on the night of 17 November.
They come from dust left by Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle and can reach 10 to 15 meteors per hour.
A dark open place and 20 to 30 minutes of eye adjustment improve the view.
Cloud may limit viewing early in the weekend, while fog may be a problem on Sunday.
Conditions near the peak may improve because moonlight will be less disruptive around midnight.

tasks.prompt: Write a short plan for a safe and comfortable Leonid-watching evening using details from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לבנות תכנית מעשית הכוללת מקום, זמן הסתגלות לחושך, בדיקת תחזית והיערכות לקור.
expected_points: Select a safe, dark and open location away from light pollution.
Check hour-by-hour cloud, fog and temperature information before leaving.
Arrive early enough to let the eyes adapt for 20 to 30 minutes.
Use the area near Leo as a guide while keeping a broad view of the sky.
Wear warm clothing because temperatures may fall into single figures.
